contribution_types.description:
Custom yogurt can sell for 2 times the price if antioxident level is extremely high. 
Available in Sprouts. Sells out really fast in San Francisco and LA but has high availability in San Luis Obispo

Insight - offline retail distribution channel does not scale evenly. Will need consideration when executing on B2B

Available in Sprouts. Sells out really fast in San Francisco and LA but has high availability in San Luis Obispo

Insight - when UVP is correctly defined product will sell even up to 2X normal retail price compared to other competitors

narrative.text: Anna Love contributed to the Agroverse project with three strategy reviews in the Build Game category during July 2023. She reviewed proposed strategies twice, suggesting clear and specific actionable steps each time, and once suggested against pursuing something or highlighted areas to watch out for.
